description: This file implements the ApplicationManagementServer class, which manages IPC communication for application management in the Rialto server. It handles initialization, event sending, starting/stopping the server thread, and client disconnection handling.

classes.name: ApplicationManagementServer
classes.description: Manages IPC communication for application lifecycle events, including initialization, event notification, and client disconnection handling.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the IPC server with a socket, sets up the client, and exports the service.

methods.name: sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends a state change event to the connected IPC client.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server thread that processes IPC events.
